definitions.explanation: A statue made of bronze or copper, typically depicting a person. Often found in parks, public squares, and in front of important buildings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{銅像|どうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A bronze statue stands in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銅像|どうぞう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ものだ。
examples.english: The bronze statue in front of the station commemorates a local hero.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋谷|しぶや}→渋谷：30632_shibuya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忠犬|ちゅうけん}→忠犬：22534_chuuken⟧ハチ{公|こう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{銅像|どうぞう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせ→待ち合わせ：07397_machiawase⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目印|めじるし}→目印：15923_mejirushi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: The bronze statue of Hachiko in Shibuya is famous as a meeting spot landmark.

notes:
USAGE:
{銅像|どうぞう} specifically refers to statues made of bronze or copper. For statues in general (regardless of material), ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ or ⟦{彫像|ちょうぞう}→彫像：22319_chouzou⟧ is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銅像|どうぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (to erect a bronze statue)
- {銅像|どうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (a bronze statue stands)
- ⟦{記念|きねん}→記念：00232_kinen⟧{銅像|どうぞう} (memorial bronze statue)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous {銅像|どうぞう} in Japan include the ⟦{忠犬|ちゅうけん}→忠犬：22534_chuuken⟧ハチ{公|こう}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (Hachiko statue) in Shibuya, the {西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (Saigo Takamori statue) in Ueno, and the {坂本龍馬|さかもとりょうま}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (Sakamoto Ryoma statue) in Kochi.
